findings.reason: at 1 % and 2 % of each row family's RMS signal the fit is nowhere near the qualification cliff that §1 measured (2–3 accepted corrections from an initial map error of 3e-2 of span), so the undecided branch is not reachable in practice and the section needs no new sentence.
findings.text: clause (3) requires the doubled-noise study to "fail clause (1)"; but clause (1) grants a state the verdict "not measured, with its count" whenever more than half the full fits fail forward qualification, so a control that lands there is neither passing nor failing the clause it is meant to falsify, and the plan gives the node no rule for that outcome
